title: 第18章 出发
novel_title: 伪装隐世仙族后，大佬疯狂跪舔我
content_zh:
“小师妹你说，是三师兄有哪里做的让你不满意，师兄改，求你别离开剑峰好不好。”

    自从跟着小师妹过上能吃灵米灵面，随时有灵果吃的日子，他就再也回不到从前了。

    如果小师妹真的要走，请把他这个忠实仆人也一起带走，不要留下他一个人在剑峰。

    突然被三师兄抱住小腿挪不动道，微生璃月真的服了，这家伙又在脑补些什么？

    “三师兄，我只是准备出去玩玩，你这是干什么？”微生璃月无奈道。

    她有时候真搞不懂，三师兄脑子里整天都装着些什么。

    难不成除了那些八卦，就是不断的脑补？

    “啊，只是出去游玩，不是要抛弃我们？”林不语惊愕，他好像猜错了事情。

    “不然呢？”

    “对不起小师妹，是我弄错了事情，我刚刚以为你要离开太虚宗再也不回来了。”

    知道小师妹身份背景不一般，很多人都当她来太虚宗只是无聊游玩，等玩够了就会离开。

    林不语听得多了，心里自然也带了这种想法。

    今天看到小师妹的动作，下意识就往这方面想，直到现在听到微生璃月的解释，他才发现自己误会了。

    “三师兄，平时没事少去听点八卦吧！”

    她感觉三师兄都快把脑子听坏了。

    “嗯嗯……我会尽量少打听的。不过小师妹，你这次出门可不可以带我一起去啊。”

    作为小师妹最忠诚的仆人，他怎么能不跟在身边伺候。

    尤其是小师妹身边还有天一这个劲敌存在，他要是不跟着，等小师妹回到太虚宗，心里哪里还有他存在的位置。

    “你也要一起去？”

    听到林不语想跟着自己，微生璃月有些诧异，这家伙平时除了在太虚宗内游荡，连山门都不下，现在竟然会主动提出要离开这里，不怕那些债主追上门讨债了？

    “嗯嗯，小师妹我要跟你一起去，求求你了……”

    受不了林不语的黏人劲，微生璃月为了保持自己精神不受污染，最后还是答应了他的请求。
content_en:
"Sister, please tell me that there is something that Third Senior Brother has done that makes you dissatisfied. Senior Brother, please don't leave Jianfeng."

Ever since he followed his junior sister and lived a life where he could eat spiritual rice, spiritual noodles, and spiritual fruits at any time, he could never go back to the past.

If Junior Sister really wants to leave, please take him, this loyal servant, with you, and don't leave him alone in Jianfeng.

Suddenly, the third senior brother hugged his calf and said, "Weisheng Liyue is really convinced. What is this guy thinking about?"

"Third Senior Brother, I'm just going out to have fun, what are you doing?" Weisheng Liyue said helplessly.

Sometimes she really couldn't understand what the third senior brother was thinking about all day long.

Is it possible that apart from the gossip, it’s just constant speculation?

"Ah, you're just going out for fun, don't you want to abandon us?" Lin Buyu was shocked. He seemed to have guessed something wrong.

"What if?"

"I'm sorry, little junior sister, I made a mistake. I just thought you were going to leave Taixu Sect and never come back."

Knowing that the junior sister's identity and background were unusual, many people thought she came to Taixu Sect just for fun and would leave when she had enough fun.

Lin Buyu listened a lot, and naturally he had this idea in his heart.

When he saw his junior sister's actions today, he subconsciously thought about it. It wasn't until he heard Wei Sheng Liyue's explanation that he realized that he had misunderstood.

"Third Senior Brother, when you have nothing to do, go and listen to some gossip!"

She felt that the third senior brother was about to lose his mind.

"Hmm...I will try to ask as little as possible. But little junior sister, can you take me with you when you go out this time?"

As the most loyal servant of Junior Sister, how could he not be by his side to serve her.

Especially when the junior sister has a powerful enemy like Tianyi beside her, if he doesn't follow her, when the junior sister returns to Taixu Sect, there will be no place for him in her heart.

"You want to go too?"

Hearing that Lin Buyu wanted to follow him, Weisheng Liyue was a little surprised. This guy usually wandered around the Taixu Sect and never left the mountain gate. Now he would take the initiative to leave here. Aren't you afraid that the creditors will come after you to collect debts?

"Yeah, little junior sister, I want to go with you, please..."

Unable to stand Lin Buyu's clinginess, Weisheng Liyue finally agreed to his request in order to keep her spirit from being polluted.
